#### NTU College of Computing and Data Science

**Best fit:** deep-learning NLP, multimodal learning, visual generation, reinforcement learning and distributed systems.

The current 2026 course activity closely matches your preferences. Direct bachelor eligibility is clearer than at Imperial or many continental European programs.

**Risks:** the opened program page does not provide a department-wide funding guarantee. Check the [NTU Postgraduate Scholarships](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/graduate/financialmatters/scholarships/) [19] page and the exact scholarship offer. Confirm whether funding has a bond, teaching requirement, qualification condition or stipend change after candidacy.
scores.rationale: Links a named option’s research and eligibility fit to a specific evidentiary funding gap, then directs concrete scholarship and offer checks before relying on the option.
